ctaBlockTitle: Find these places in Chicago on your phone
seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Chicago
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Chicago it currently holds 280 public toilets and 247 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: 431 of the 3,532 places mapped in Chicago are recorded as free of charge.
